# GH-300 Study Planner Source Pack

Use these references to ensure plans are objective-driven, voice-consistent, and exam aligned.

## Local source files

- [Maintained writing guide](../../../../references/style-guide.md)
- [Study plan quality checklist](study-plan-quality-checklist.md)
- [GH-300 domains and objectives](../../../../references/gh300-objectives.md), effective August 7, 2026
- [Public Microsoft Writing Style Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/style-guide/welcome/)

## Planner defaults

- Cover all six GH-300 skill areas.
- Prioritize weak or unknown areas first.
- Use weight ranges, not fixed percentages.
- Keep recommendations practical and time-bounded.
